doc.title: "Papa Jack" Laine, Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine and Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1959-02-27

title: Pacquet and Dave Perkins and their ancestry
summary: They discuss the skin colour and background of Achille Pacquet and Dave Perkins.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: You heard of Ashil Pacquet playing clarinet, haven't you? He played good, he played good.
So was Dave Perkins. Married a white girl though. Perkins was fair. Married a white girl. Poikins was fair as a lily and had blue eyes and blonde hair. He had colored blood.
He looked more on a German type or an Irish. He really did. You could never, never think of it.
